correctness.rationale: For free nonunital 2-step associative algebra N(V)=V⊕(V⊗V), triples vanish and every algebra endomorphism has F(v+w)=Av+f(v)+(A⊗A)w because multiplication of generator images determines all degree-2 action. For commuting idempotent F_i, the induced A_i and B_i=A_i⊗A_i are commuting idempotents. Simultaneously splitting the short exact sequence 0→W→N→V→0 for the commutative semisimple algebra of k idempotents gives a shared equivariant section, realized by one algebra shear H_h, conjugating all F_i to graded E_i. Distinct quotient joint eigenspace multiplicities n_epsilon (epsilon∈{0,1}^k) classify conjugacy; joint eigenspace W_eta dimensions m_eta=sum_{epsilon∧delta=eta} n_epsilon n_delta. For each quotient decomposition GL_n/∏GL_n_epsilon, shared shear choices quotient Hom(V,W) by commuting intertwiners of dimension E=sum n_eta m_eta, yielding q^(n^3-E). Each nonempty composite rank r_I+r_I^2. This holds in every characteristic, with finite field q only for numerical counting. Independently recomputed n=k=q=2 orbit-sum count 868; single retraction total 98 and product-rank splitting agree in the explicit result; boundary n=1 checked algebraically. This finite arithmetic supports but cannot prove general splitting or count.
